## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the requirement, issue or recorded decision. State intended behaviour and scope.
For a significant proposal, link prior discussion and alternatives; trivial fixes need no proposal document.

## Contracts and decisions

Identify affected modules and interface, boundary or invariant changes. Link a new ADR or the existing applicable decision, or state why none is needed. Keep unrelated work in separate PRs.

## Validation

Record exact checks actually run, their results (including failures), and omitted checks with reasons.
For research, distinguish synthetic demonstration from real-world evidence; report chronological evaluation, simpler baselines, negative results and attention costs where relevant.

## Data and control boundaries

Describe changes to data access, permissions, dependencies, workflows, sensing or control authority.
Explain how strictly non-actuating shadow research is preserved. Never include private health data, identifiable recordings, secrets or signing credentials. Security disclosures use SECURITY.md.

## Attribution, review and follow-up

Record third-party provenance/licences, relevant conflicts of interest, unresolved questions and limitations.
Identify required expertise and any independent-review gap. Agent review is not independent human approval.
Passing checks does not authorize automatic merge, release, deployment or repository security changes.
